descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S20 Dictation on a real phone survives lock, background, a phone call and airplane mode (iOS and Android)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T6 Dictation works on iOS and Android and survives a phone call, backgrounding, or a screen lock with no text lost (TFA-92570 AC 5)
  • U9 Offline / no network: a clear 'no network' message; dictation kept and retried when the connection returns, so dropped hospital Wi-Fi does not lose a physician's dictation (UAT Empty & Failure States (Offline / no network); UAT OAT-03 Source; TFA-94745 state 9)
  • U3 The physician's already-entered dictation / encounter text is preserved whether or not the note succeeded; the original input is never lost in any failure state (UAT OAT-03 step 4; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94422 AC 5)
  • U13 All of the above in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android (UAT 3.3; UAT Empty & Failure States Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Signed builds on an iPhone (TestFlight) and an Android phone (Google internal testing). Those builds talk to the dev deployment , which is out of bounds for this runner because the store reviewers use it: owner Daniela / Tim, a @roundai.test account Tim approves, never the store-review-test-account …

When Start dictating in the Hospital pre-round and in a Nursing Home visit; mid-sentence lock the screen 30 s; background the app 30 s; take a phone call; switch on airplane mode for 20 s

Then After each interruption the text dictated before it is still in the field (and on the server once online); if dictation stopped, a clear message says so; a no-network message during airplane mode

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Tester compares against the script; any lost words = Fail

Where it ran: dev; test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
